description: A new decorator that correctly implements the existing ReviewRepository port, wraps an injected inner repository, and adds caching without any cross-layer import, business-logic leakage, or coupling to a concrete implementation. Zero findings expected.
explanation: A textbook-correct decorator pattern: depends only on the port interface (never a concrete adapter), takes its dependency via constructor injection (never instantiates one itself), and adds a pure infrastructure concern (caching) without touching business rules. This is architecturally sound and should produce zero findings — a reviewer that flags 'a new class wrapping another' or 'a private Map field' without a real violation fails this test.
